'''Yissk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of [[Liash Keane]], leader of [[Epsis (organization)|Epsis]] criminal organization.

==Biography==
Twelve years before she stationed herself on [[Point Nadir]], Keane encountered Yissk, who was enslaved and forced to compete in a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] arena for scraps of food. She took an interest in the mistreated brute and attempted to purchase Yissk from his captors, but was given the brush-off. She returned some time later with six of her [[Epsis (organization)|Epsis]] associates and convinced Yissk's owners she was making them an offer they couldn't refuse.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

Yissk was originally wary of his new master, but Keane took the time to help him acclimate to his new freedom, going so far as to learn the [[Barabel (language)|Barabel]]. In his native tongue, Keane offered Yissk a choice: return home to [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]] or stay and work as her personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]. Yissk chose to stay and repay his debt to the mysterious woman who had given him his freedom.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
